verdict.rationale: iTerm2 has a built-in LLM chat window that can link to sessions and "run commands on your behalf" (iterm2-gh-6). The generative AI features need a separately installed optional AI plugin (iterm2-docs-15), so the core delegation exists but rests on one thin GitHub summary. missing for 10: evidence of multi-step planning, a documented per-command approval/confirmation flow, in-depth first-party docs on agentic execution, and independent hands-on corroboration.
